The three states of matter are solid, liquid and gas.
Which list shows three distinguishing properties of most liquids?
A
fixed shape, easily compressed, lowest density
B
fixed shape, fixed volume, highest density
C
fixed volume, able to flow, easily compressed
D
fixed volume, able to flow, no fixed shape

options.label: A
options.text: fixed shape, easily compressed, lowest density

options.label: B
options.text: fixed shape, fixed volume, highest density

options.label: C
options.text: fixed volume, able to flow, easily compressed

options.label: D
options.text: fixed volume, able to flow, no fixed shape
